summary.business_type: Local service / travel agency (referral brand + licensed operator)
top_findings: All five critical findings from the 31 October audit are resolved: review markup, cache lifetimes, identity, Search Console, image/logo.
CrUX still returns no data after four weeks — real traffic is below the eligibility threshold, and that is the actual bottleneck.
Mobile home-page performance regressed 93 -> 87, LCP 3.1s -> 3.5s, confirmed over three runs.
docs/google-business-profile.md contains the literal string 'undefined' four times, in a document meant to be pasted into a public Google listing.
The GetYourGuide widget is correctly click-to-load: zero third-party requests before the click, verified on production.
quick_wins: Fix the four 'undefined' values in the Google Business Profile sheet (scripts/make-gbp-sheet.mjs reads fields that moved into site.operator).
Shorten two meta descriptions over 165 characters.
Query one resource of each type when checking cache headers — the repo crawler only reads the HTML document's header.

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: 40 pages crawled, 0 broken internal links
Cache lifetimes correct per resource type: immutable year on fingerprinted assets, one day plus background revalidation on photos
www redirects 301 to apex
Search Console verified by DNS TXT
Six security and cache headers present, none missing

findings.title: The repo crawler reports only the HTML document's Cache-Control
findings.description: scripts/check-seo.py prints 'max-age=0, must-revalidate' regardless of how static assets are cached, which reads as an unfixed problem.
findings.recommendation: Query one resource of each type with curl -I; consider extending the script.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: 40 pages, none under 300 words
New 1,500-word tool page
217 FAQ questions marked up and 217 <details> rendered — exact match
Identity resolved: brand and operator are separate entities, relationship stated in the header

findings.title: No named author on the guides
findings.description: author resolves to the organisation node, not a Person, so E-E-A-T's experience criterion has nothing to measure.
findings.recommendation: Name someone who has actually read and will stand behind the page; the JSON-LD switches to Person on its own.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Titles and descriptions within limits on 36 of 40 pages
Single h1, no skipped heading levels
Canonical consistent with URL

findings.title: Four metadata reserves on forty pages
findings.description: /blog/ has no og:image; two descriptions exceed 165 characters; /credits-photos/ is noindex so its short description is moot.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: No Review nodes and no aggregateRating anywhere
Brand Organization and operator TravelAgency separated, linked by parentOrganization
Licence attributed to its holder via hasCredential
image and logo present on the brand node
All internal @id references resolve

findings.title: image and logo absent from the operator node
findings.description: TravelAgency now describes Jasmin Travel's business, not the site's. Both fields are recommended for LocalBusiness.
findings.recommendation: Ask Jasmin for their own images, or leave empty. Do not fill it with a stock photo of Ha Long bay.

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: Desktop 99 home / 100 planner
CLS 0 everywhere
TBT 3ms home, 8.5ms planner
Planner page scores 97 mobile despite carrying the site's only client component

findings.title: Mobile home-page performance regressed
findings.description: 86/88/88 over three runs with LCP stable at 3.49s, against 93 and 3.1s on 31 October. Measured contributors: 12KB render-blocking CSS costing 179ms, and a new third party — Cloudflare Web Analytics, 10.6KB, 11.6ms main thread. Together they do not account for 400ms; the rest is the hero image, with 509KB of images on the page against 0 on the planner page.
findings.recommendation: Do not optimise the hero until CrUX returns field data. Lab LCP is not real LCP.

findings.title: CrUX still has no data after four weeks
findings.description: 'Insufficient Chrome traffic volume for eligibility'. The previous plan said to revisit in 4-6 weeks; the answer is that traffic has not reached the threshold.
findings.recommendation: Treat traffic as the bottleneck, not speed. Watch Search Console impressions, now that the property is verified.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: 217 FAQ answers present in the HTML even when collapsed
55 tables — the format most reused in generative answers
Content-Signal header declares search=yes, ai-input=yes, ai-train=no
No robot-specific blocks; all pass through User-agent: *
llms.txt mentions the new tool page

findings.title: Brand presence is still nil
findings.description: No Wikipedia, Reddit, YouTube or LinkedIn presence. Brand mentions correlate with AI citation far more strongly than backlinks.
findings.recommendation: YouTube, then Reddit — participate rather than publish. No code fixes this.

categories.name: Images
what_works: WebP, six widths, alt text on every image in main
Photos cached one day with a week of background revalidation

findings.title: 509KB of images on the home page
findings.description: Six image requests against zero on the planner page, which scores ten points higher on mobile.
findings.recommendation: Revisit once CrUX has field data; the loading strategy is already correct.

phases.name: Phase 1: Critical Fixes
items: Fix four 'undefined' values in docs/google-business-profile.md, and decide which legal name the Google listing should carry
Add og:image to /blog/ and shorten two meta descriptions

phases.name: Phase 2: The real subject
items: Treat traffic as the bottleneck: brand presence on YouTube, Reddit, LinkedIn
Watch Search Console impressions now the property is verified
Name a real author on the guides

phases.name: Phase 3: When CrUX speaks
items: Retry CrUX; the day it returns data the site crossed a real threshold
Only then work the hero image weight
Ask Jasmin for operator images, or leave the fields empty

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring & Iteration
items: Check one resource of each type when verifying cache headers
Quarterly guide review; move dateModified only when the text is reopened
